plan.root_cause: The header component's init() method unconditionally calls syncState() with the menu's --open class state. At desktop widths, the navigation is visually visible (CSS displays it) but lacks the --open class (only used for mobile), so syncState(false) sets aria-hidden="true" on the navigation, hiding it from assistive technology despite being visible on screen.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify Header.prototype.init to detect mobile mode by checking if the menu button is visible (offsetWidth/Height > 0). In desktop mode (button hidden), explicitly set aria-hidden="false" on the navigation and skip click handler registration. In mobile mode, retain existing toggle behavior.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Navigation links in the header will be exposed as named links (role="link" with accessible names "Apply", "Renew a licence", "Fishing rules") to assistive technology on desktop-width pages, allowing keyboard and screen reader users to reach and activate them.
functional_risks: Mobile menu toggle behavior unchanged; only desktop initialization path altered.
Relies on offsetWidth/offsetHeight at init time; script runs at end of body so layout is ready.
No visual changes; only ARIA attribute correction.
verification_requirements: At desktop width: navigation links have role="link" and accessible names matching visible text.
At desktop width: navigation element has aria-hidden="false".
At mobile width: menu button click toggles aria-hidden and aria-expanded correctly.
Keyboard navigation reaches all three header links in order.

plan.root_cause: The header component's init() method unconditionally calls syncState() with the menu's --open class state. At desktop widths, the navigation is visually visible (CSS displays it) but lacks the --open class (only used for mobile), so syncState(false) sets aria-hidden="true" on the navigation, hiding it from assistive technology despite being visible on screen. Additionally, the previous fix omitted setting aria-expanded on the menu button, causing it to be null instead of the expected "false".
plan.repair_strategy: Modify Header.prototype.init to detect mobile mode by checking if the menu button is visible (offsetWidth/Height > 0). In desktop mode (button hidden), explicitly set aria-hidden="false" on the navigation and aria-expanded="false" on the menu button, and skip click handler registration. In mobile mode, retain existing toggle behavior.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Navigation links in the header will be exposed as named links (role="link" with accessible names "Apply", "Renew a licence", "Fishing rules") to assistive technology on desktop-width pages, allowing keyboard and screen reader users to reach and activate them. The menu button will have aria-expanded="false" as expected.
